subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR wait for current-head live proof through official `minimax` or `minimax-portal`, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The implementation direction has already been reviewed, but the available screenshot and Ollama evidence do not exercise the provider path that the current force-pushed wrapper changes; only a maintainer can explicitly accept that residual delivery risk without the required external-PR proof.

options.title: Require official-provider proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live output, logs, a transcript, or a Telegram recording from official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal on commit `e29b2fab`, then re-review and merge after lint is green.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may apply `proof: override` and accept the mocked stream coverage plus documented marker contract, while still requiring the lint failure to be resolved.

recommendation.title: Require official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live output, logs, a transcript, or a Telegram recording from official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal on commit `e29b2fab`, then re-review and merge after lint is green.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer already made the ownership-layer decision and paused automerge for the current behavior.
